cases.description: Reverse in the public carriageway directly across the surveyed station entrance without entering the driveway.

physical_risk.risk: Turn radius may carry the body into the driveway or out of the original cameras.

physical_risk.trigger_metric: full-body overlap with surveyed entrance/approach polygons, route completion and source image coverage
physical_risk.failure_condition: Subject fails the intended path or exits the mapped region or camera view.
